name: bionemo-phage-design
description: Recipe-local skills for reproducible Evo 2 phage design workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run and interpret Evo 2 phage-design experiments.
interface.longDescription: Plan and run evidence-backed complete-genome phage design with lifecycle-wide host-range analysis, Evo 2 SFT, GDPO optimization, checkpoint selection, quality control, telemetry, and selective artifact publication.
defaultPrompt: Plan a whole-genome Evo 2 phage-design experiment.
Run the PhiX174 case study and keep useful experimental notes.
Review training trends and select a checkpoint for final screening.
